text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
That makes three laps done!
choice_data_list: Good work. That's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Um, could I get two more, please!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling super great right now!
I think I can get an even better time!
choice_data_list: Still, with the race coming up, running too much might...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not tired at all!
Zero miles on this engine!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I feel totally fine intuitively too!
When you're tired, your senses get dull, you know."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my head's completely clear right now!
I don't want to miss this chance!
choice_data_list: ...All right. We stop the moment anything feels off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No loose horseshoes here!
Yep! All ready to go♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This feeling is just like how it felt during the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My physical form might still be unrefined, but...
my "instincts" are flawless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Her ‘instincts’ are highly reliable.
Her powerful performances so far are proof enough of that.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As far as I can tell, her condition looks fine too.
On top of that, if her 'feel' is spot-on—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, it's 1600m!
I'll run an even better race than the Oka Sho!
